subject: Discovery follow-up: VP/CTO intro & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@zenlyx.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@zenlyx.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-08T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: VP/CTO intro & next steps

Hi Sanjay / Priya -

Thanks again for the call today - great to hear more about Zenlyx's roadmap for customer-facing AI assistants. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we can unblock procurement and technical validation: 

- Primary goals: reduce inference cost by ~30% vs current setup, hit p95 latency <180ms for 1k qps, and ensure audit logging for regulatory requirements.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Priya (CTO), Sanjay (Head of Product), and Security (TBD).

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive alignment (15-20m): Marissa/Marcus (Redwood) intro with Priya/CTO to align on SLAs, deployment options (Dedicated vs Private), and procurement timeline.
2) Technical deep-dive / demo (45m): walk-through of runtime, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and integration checklist. Evelyn (SE) will lead.
3) Security questionnaire and evidence exchange: we'll share SOC2, KMS/HSM integration notes, and an ARM template for your infra team.

Can we lock in an exec intro next week? Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 2028-10-11 10:00-10:20
- Thu 2028-10-12 08:30-08:50
- Thu 2028-10-12 16:00-16:20

If those don't work, share a slot and we'll accommodate. Also including a mutual action plan and our ARM template attached for your review. Calendly: https://cal.com/marissa/redwood-demo

Attachments: zenlyx_mutual_action_plan.pdf, redwood_arm_template.docx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182
